WOODWORK — MOCK EXAM #2
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: WOODWORK
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. CPU
   B. Monitor
   C. Speaker
   D. Keyboard

2. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Overload every socket
   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

3. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
   B. Work alone with eyes closed
   C. Remove all guards
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

4. When learning Timber conversion and seasoning, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Timber conversion and seasoning.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Timber conversion and seasoning.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Timber conversion and seasoning.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Timber conversion and seasoning.
